top_signals.title: Russia’s Crude Output Fell in August as Ukraine Steps Up Strikes
top_signals.summary: Russia’s production of crude oil shrank in August, lagging further behind its OPEC+ quota, after Ukraine stepped up attacks on the nation’s oil assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Gold Falls as Traders Raise Fed Hike Bets After US Price Report
top_signals.summary: Gold fell as the latest US inflation report and surging crude prices reinforced bets that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates this month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Russian e-commerce giant Wildberries says DDoS attack delayed payments to sellers
top_signals.summary: Wildberries told several Russian media outlets earlier this week that payments to some sellers were delayed by security measures introduced after a distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack targeted systems used to track and withdraw their earnings.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
